question: Why does the island drop frames occasionally at the 60 FPS cap, and which causes can the terrain streamer remove?
device: M2 Max, macOS, release builds, battery power, 1280x720-point window (2560x1440 surface), --fps 60, --weather clear

signals.presentation: Metal HUD log (MTL_HUD_ENABLED=1 MTL_HUD_LOG_ENABLED=1), every other pair (the 120 Hz display logs each 60 Hz frame twice), late = interval > 20 ms
signals.attribution: per-frame slow-system log over the existing CPU system wrappers (main world and render world)

still_scene_late_frames_per_second.note: Identical still view; HUD GPU time rose from about 7 ms to 13-15 ms partway through runs with an unchanged cover (GPU performance state). Late share by frame GPU time: about 5% below 10 ms, 23-33% at 12-14 ms.

final.note: the 1.49 run was bursts in Bevy transform/animation systems; they did not reproduce in two reruns

in_game_terrain_update.note: p90 over frames whose main-thread total exceeded 3 ms. HUD late frames stayed at 0-0.3/s for both binaries in these sessions (good GPU state), so this measures removed CPU spikes, not a proven change in visible misses.

open: Bevy 0.19 compiles pipelines synchronously on macOS (60-230 ms per new variant)
grass page changes repack the whole grass scene; object pages spawn in bursts
weather transitions keep wind strength in the grass placement key
GPU performance state at the 60 cap leaves about 11-12 ms of GPU budget
